Truly exhilerating! I find myself spending countless hours playing alone against the perfected AI that is the computer. If somehow that wasn't enough to convince you then just try the multiplayer; it's incredibly intense! Possibly my favourite game perhaps just behind Unturned. Definitely worth a download!

And now for the pros and cons:

Pros
 
Crystal clear audio
Refined graphics
Intense and intricate design
Beautifully complex

Cons

Quite beefy on the storage side
Long download time
Requires expensive setup
Spelt "Noughts and Crosses" incorrectly  in the title

Overall this is just a bunch of fun for free. Also the developers announced that there will be no season pass or paid DLC for this game which is amazing! I honestly believe that other game developers could take example from this masterpiece in all aspects.
